The '''Aerodrive Thruster Augmentation System''' was a maneuvering [[Engine/Legends|thruster]] produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its purpose was to increase the maneuverability of small vessels.
